gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-supreme: The plain sans body looks like a thick, heavy strip, its letters held open rather than curled shut. Supreme is best at crisp text, while Over the Rainbow does casual, personal handwriting from a thin bent-rod line.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-satoshi: Loose and handwritten on top: Over the Rainbow looks like thin steel rod bent into letters. And Satoshi, tall and open with a wide e, keeps reading friendly and never squeezed.
gen-gf-pangolin-fs-asap: Pangolin looks drawn with a single nib, its lowercase tall and generous. Asap draws its c as an open arc and keeps its lowercase nearly capital height, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-pangolin-fs-erode: A tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of weight give the body its dignified voice. Erode keeps text flowing with broad openings on the g and a, while Pangolin stays friendly and relaxed.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-literata: Friendly, hand-drawn letters from Playpen Sans Arabic keep a constant-width stroke, with curve tips that never quite touch. Literata adds bookish sophistication through curves that thicken gently at the shoulders.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-deva-fs-bespoke-sans: Inviting, casually drawn letters from Playpen Sans Deva trace every stroke with one fixed nib, their terminals cut open. Bespoke Sans adds sharp refinement, with generous room where curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-hebrew-fs-bespoke-sa: Graceful letters from Playpen Sans Hebrew open outward, never curling in. Bespoke Sans sharpens things with refined curves that keep generous space from the stem, while the heading's line never swells.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-fs-bespoke-sans: Friendly, casual letters from Playpen Sans Thai, each stroke weighing the same. Bespoke Sans then settles into sharp, refined reading, leaving generous space between curve ends and stem so text moves smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-graduate: Wide-mouthed and expressive, Shantell Sans draws every curve with one fixed nib. Graduate is best at dignified, bookish text, with generous white between letters and no contrast between stems and joins.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-graduate: Quiet, level and commanding, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back in. Graduate follows with dignified, bookish text and generous white between letters, giving the display lines a steady partner.
